title: The ZAP Docker images
description: How the docker directory of zaproxy developed: the first Dockerfiles in 2014, packaged scan scripts, live and bare images, a HUD change, and registry changes in 2023 and 2024.

chapters.title: First Dockerfiles, 2014
chapters.text: The commit "Dockerfile needed for building the latest stable (2.3.1) release of zap." (2014-09-24) adds build/docker/Dockerfile-stable. "Dockerfile for building weekly zap release. Does not download any addons, only the weekly.zip." (2014-09-26) adds build/docker/Dockerfile-weekly.

chapters.title: Packaged scan scripts, 2016 and 2017
chapters.text: "Added zap-baseline scan" (2016-05-12) adds python/api/src/examples/zap-baseline.py. "Added baseline script and reworked dockerfiles" (2016-05-13) adds build/docker/zap-baseline.py. "Package API scan script" (2017-05-19) adds zap-api-scan.py under build/docker, and "zap-full-scan.py - first version" (2017-06-12) adds build/docker/zap-full-scan.py.

chapters.title: Live and bare images, 2017
chapters.text: "Create a new docker image for a ZAP live image" (2017-01-26) adds build/docker/Dockerfile-live. "added bare docker image file" (2017-08-08) adds build/docker/Dockerfile-bare.

chapters.title: The docker directory moves to the top level, 2018
chapters.text: "Move docker dir to a top level dir" (2018-03-07) renames the files under build/docker, including Dockerfile-bare, Dockerfile-live, Dockerfile-stable, and Dockerfile-weekly, to docker/.

chapters.title: The HUD and the live image, 2018 and 2019
chapters.text: "Include the HUD add-on in live Docker image" (2018-12-05) says it changes Dockerfile-live to build and include the HUD add-on. "Fix Docker live image" (2019-06-10) says it uses Gradle tasks to create the release in the live image, and changes docker/Dockerfile-live and buildSrc/src/main/kotlin/org/zaproxy/zap/distributions.gradle.kts.

chapters.title: Registries, 2023 and 2024
chapters.text: "Push Docker images to GHCR" (2023-06-07) adds a docker/CHANGELOG.md entry dated 2023-06-08 saying images are published to the GitHub Container Registry with tags instead of image names, for example "ghcr.io/zaproxy/zaproxy:weekly" instead of the old name "owasp/zap2docker-weekly:latest". A ZAP blog post dated 2023-06-13 lists the matching images on both registries. "Publish Docker images to SSP DockerHub organization" is dated 2023-08-02. "Docker: No longer push to OWASP Docker Hub" (2024-03-05) adds a docker/CHANGELOG.md entry dated 2024-03-05. The post "ZAP is Joining the Software Security Project" (2023-08-01) says the Docker Hub images were under the OWASP organisation account and would move to a new organisation, changing the pull URLs, while "The GitHub Container Registry images will not be affected." The 2.11.0 post (2021-10-07) had announced a different rhythm: "The Docker stable and bare images will now be updated monthly, typically around the start of the month."
